name: Supplies to Tannok
summary: A crate bound for Tannok Frosthammer waits at the mouth of Coldridge Pass. Hands Springsprocket asks travelers to carry the inn supplies from Coldridge Valley to the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, since troggs have cut off the usual trade routes.

sections.title: A Blockaded Valley
sections.body: Troggs have overrun Coldridge Pass, straining Coldridge Valley’s ties to the rest of Dun Morogh. The valley has long sheltered young Ironforge dwarves and Gnomeregan survivors in exile. Now the mountain pass is perilous to cross. Mountaineers are spread thin guarding settlements and defensive perimeters, so scheduled supply escorts can be delayed for days.

sections.title: Hands and the Innkeeper's Assistant
sections.body: At the mouth of Coldridge Pass, the gnome tinkerer Hands Springsprocket waits with a crate of supplies for the inn in Kharanos. He cannot safely carry it there himself. Travelers preparing to cross the pass can take the cargo to Tannok Frosthammer, the assistant at the Thunderbrew inn.

sections.title: A Welcoming Hearth in Kharanos
sections.body: Kharanos marks your arrival in the wider lands of Dun Morogh. Tannok Frosthammer receives the supplies and says word from Anvilmar has been scarce since troggs disrupted travel through the pass. The delivery restores a fragile link of communication and trade between the two isolated dwarf communities.

faq.answer: Hands Springsprocket is a gnome tinkerer waiting at the mouth of Coldridge Pass in Coldridge Valley. He asks travelers to carry goods to Kharanos because he cannot safely cross the pass alone.
Tannok Frosthammer is the assistant at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. He receives provisions sent from places such as Anvilmar.

faq.q: Why can't Hands deliver the supplies himself?
faq.answer: Troggs have overrun the pass between Coldridge Valley and Kharanos, making travel dangerous. Mountaineer escorts are also delayed because they are spread thin guarding settlements and defenses.

faq.q: Where is the inn in Kharanos located?
faq.answer: The Thunderbrew Distillery is in the center of Kharanos, along the main road east toward Ironforge. Tannok Frosthammer is inside.

faq.q: What is inside the Crate of Inn Supplies?
faq.answer: The crate holds tavern supplies and provisions gathered in Anvilmar for the Thunderbrew inn in Kharanos.

faq.q: Why is communication between Anvilmar and Kharanos cut off?
faq.answer: Troggs from subterranean tunnels have overrun Coldridge Pass. Their presence has disrupted foot travel and regular dispatches between Coldridge Valley and the rest of Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a dwarf, carrying supplies from Anvilmar to Kharanos takes you beyond the sheltered valley and into service to Ironforge.
As a gnome, helping Hands Springsprocket shows the cooperation between Gnomeregan exiles and their dwarven hosts in Dun Morogh.
As an Alliance member, restoring trade between isolated outposts helps keep Ironforge’s inland supply lines moving despite trogg incursions.
